test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
‘Q + R’ means ‘Q is the father of R’

‘Q – R’ means ‘Q is the wife of R’

‘Q × R’ means ‘Q is the brother of R’

‘Q ÷ R’ means ‘Q is the daughter of R’.

What does ‘ M – N + O’ mean?

options.text: M is the daughter of O
M is the mother of O
M is the father of O
M is the brother of O

solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0634b524b013097d361d40acb3f433749c8ad65eceeabfeb06f3b682eb43ad71.png] 

Given equation: **M – N + O**

 
 

 **Code**
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 **Relation**
 Father
 Wife
 Brother
 Daughter
 
 

The family tree can be drawn as per the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee64f8f675994ef4062fe057465d6fd42e67ea532fdd587ef6493f882de248de.png] 

Here, we can see that M is the mother of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"M is the mother of O"**.
